purpose: Extend the existing Gekta P0 SPEED diagnostic with bounded read-only capacity and separate baseline HTTP, model-alias and swap observations, without inference, root access, service mutation, context loss or OOM risk.
requiredBehavior: reuse only the dedicated protected model-host SSH identity and pinned host key
run entirely as the existing least-privilege model-host SSH principal

publish the existing 28 whitelisted CPU topology memory PSS service policy executable identity and llama.cpp scheduling facts plus exactly four closed baseline HTTP/model-alias/swap observation fields
never print environment contents credentials filesystem paths raw command line prompt response model bytes or customer data
validate the existing non-root baseline owner, service PID, unchanged command line, process start time, same network namespace and an owned listening socket before one bounded GET /v1/models

allow only the accepted baseline private address or an actually bound loopback address at fixed port 18080 with the exact baseline alias and scheduling profile; reject arbitrary hosts ports DNS redirects and candidate port 18081
use a single existing baseline CLI or LLAMA_API_KEY credential only in memory; reject duplicates multiple values key files or ambiguous sources
report HTTP status model alias and swap independently; nonzero swap does not suppress an authorized read-only HTTP observation and HTTP success does not imply zero swap or inference acceptance
forbiddenCapabilities: production VPS credentials as fallback model-host authority
sudo su doas or any other privilege escalation
systemctl restart start stop enable disable daemon-reload or edit
file write chmod chown package install process signal or alternate model process on the model host
printing any secret environment value filesystem path or arbitrary ExecStart argument
new server paid API SaaS or recurring cost
model inference POST requests redirects arbitrary endpoints or a new control-plane transport
credential output or export to another process file runner argument environment or HTTP target
refunding resetting or reusing the spent candidate execution grant, or authorizing candidate retry extra service restart apply rollback or cleanup bypass

httpObservationContract.sourceTargetAuthority: .github/workflows/tai-qwen-model-host-repair.yml accepted private listener and scripts/pc-tai-release-controller-core.sh baseline constants
httpObservationContract.sourceAcceptanceRequired: Fresh exact-source independent review, separate owner audit, all applicable native CI/security and ordinary full-SHA manual merge. This scope proposal is not runtime success or a candidate grant.
